LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading aloud (Fluency) (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, th
Topic 2.9: Reading aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading aloud, part of Reading 2.7 Reading aloud (Fluency) (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, th in Grade 7 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why do we read aloud?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify sentence melody in reading for fluency,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading aloud in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. read texts aloud for fluency,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading aloud in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. recognise the value of reading aloud for building fluency.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading aloud in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify sentence melody in reading for fluency,

   Reading aloud helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. read texts aloud for fluency,

   Reading aloud helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. recognise the value of reading aloud for building fluency.

   Reading aloud helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. underline expressions referring to family (Vater, Mutter, Schwester, Bruder usw),

2. write down members of their nuclear family and present to classmates by their name, age, and profession in plenary,

3. draw and present to peers a family tree indicating their family members,

4. research about dynamics of family in German-speaking countries, write them down, and present them in plenary.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. underline expressions referring to family (Vater, Mutter, Schwester, Bruder usw),
2. write down members of their nuclear family and present to classmates by their name, age, and profession in plenary,
3. draw and present to peers a family tree indicating their family members,
4. research about dynamics of family in German-speaking countries, write them down, and present them in plenary.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: the learner enhances their teamwork skills as they read aloud simulations of giving

directions around their neighborhood with peers using expressions such as wie komme ich..? Wo finde ich..?

• Self-efficacy: the learner develops task management skills as they read aloud simulations of giving directions around their

neighborhood with peers using expressions such as wie komme ich..? Wo finde ich..?

37

Values:
Respect: the learner observes rules of social interactions as they read aloud simulations of giving directions around their

neighborhood with peers using expressions such as wie komme ich..? Wo finde ich..?

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Citizenship: the learner enhances their knowledge and appreciation of their neighbourhood as they read aloud simulations of

giving directions around their neighborhood with peers using expressions such as wie komme ich..? Wo finde ich..?

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links their knowledge of prepositions of location to similar concepts acquired in English and Kiswahili.

38
